scope: C6 anti-recorder model v2 (corrected); independent; not admitted
headline_corrections: v1 nonce-bound "verification" was circular: a reseal keyed on whatever the fake environment answered is self-consistent and verifies NOTHING. Offline verification fundamentally requires build-time mirrors, i.e. constant challenges.
dual-path consistency kills pure replay of novel queries but is trivially satisfied by a symmetric fake; it only forces replay tools to become emulators.
every real defense here is a cost ladder rung, not a wall: exact replay < symmetric fake < stateful fake < full semantic emulator < in-run hook (R004).
false_positive_ledger: unstable probe mirrored from one variant garbles legit users on other variants (P3)
stateful probes garble environments that legitimately reset state
dual-path partners must be provably identical across ALL target variants (the 52 constraint, applied twice)
